items.title: 軟體公司Ahsay再度修補已遭串連及利用的備份管理平臺AhsayCBS零時差漏洞
items.summary: 上週威脅情報公司Huntress指出，近日公布的備份管理平臺Ahsay Cloud Backup Server（AhsayCBS）資安漏洞CVE-2026-105133、CVE-2026-105134被用於實際攻擊，本週軟體公司Ahsay發布更新予以修補。

items.title: 思科修補已遭利用的郵件安全閘道任意檔案寫入漏洞
items.summary: 10月14日思科發布資安公告，旗下郵件安全閘道系統Secure Email Gateway（SEG）存在任意檔案寫入漏洞CVE-2026-76519，此弱點存在於惡意軟體防護機制Advanced Malware Protection（AMP），未通過身分驗證的攻擊者，可遠端於底層作業系統寫入任意檔案，CVSS嚴重程度評分為9.8。思科警告，該漏洞已遭積極利用，且目前沒有替代的緩解措施，呼籲用戶儘速套用軟體更新因應。

items.title: 美國司法部跨州打擊北韓遠端工作網路，起訴14人並破獲筆電農場
items.summary: 美國司法部10月13日宣布在俄亥俄州與德州展開協同行動，打擊北韓利用IT工作者滲透美國企業、取得非法收入的網路。美國司法部指出，北韓人員利用竊取或偽造的美國身分應徵遠端職位，再透過美國境內協力者代管企業配發的筆電，掩飾實際工作地點，並將薪資收入轉往北韓相關帳戶。

items.title: Palo Alto Networks修補遭利用的防火牆作業系統遠端程式碼執行漏洞
items.summary: 10月15日資安公司Palo Alto Networks提出警告，旗下防火牆作業系統PAN-OS存在高風險漏洞CVE-2026-0322，且該漏洞已遭利用。此為管理介面當中的遠端程式碼執行（RCE）弱點，擁有網路存取權限的攻擊者可在防火牆上，以root權限執行任意程式碼，CVSS v4.0嚴重程度評分為8.6，影響PA系列的實體防火牆設備、VM系列的虛擬防火牆，以及防火牆集中管理平臺Panorama，不影響雲端防火牆Cloud NGFW、安全存取服務邊緣（SASE）平臺Prisma Access。

items.title: Shadowserver警示仍有數百組Danfoss冷藏控制器暴露於公開網路
items.summary: 法國數百家超市近日發生Danfoss冷藏控制系統遭駭事件，駭客遠端操控設備啟動除霜功能，導致溫度異常升高，大量生鮮及冷凍食品報廢。

items.title: SpaceXSI推出Grok Voice 3.0，語音評測奪冠
items.summary: SpaceX旗下AI部門SpaceXSI周三（10/14）推出新一代語音模型Grok Voice 3.0，在第三方評測機構Artificial Analysis的語音對語音綜合指數（Speech-to-Speech Index）中，以86.9分排名第一，超越OpenAI及Google的競爭模型。新模型主打快速語音回應與企業客服應用，SpaceXSI宣稱回應時間可低於1秒。

items.title: fix(failover): skip same-model retries for Chinese quota exhaustion (…
items.summary: fix(failover): skip same-model retries for Chinese quota exhaustion (#172173) * fix(failover): treat Chinese usage-cap messages as periodic limits A provider that reports an exhausted usage window in Chinese (MiniMax Token Plan 2056: "已达到 Token Plan 用量上限：请升级 Token Plan 套餐或购买积分补充用量。", no Retry-After header) was classified as an ordinary transient rate limit, so the run burned the same-model retry spiral on a provider that cannot recover until the window resets. The English periodic wording already classified correctly. Extend the periodic-usage predicate with the Chinese usage/quota cap phrasing, keeping length/context caps and transient rate-limit messages out of that path. * fix(failover): recognize the Chinese usage cap in the retry window Review finding (P2): classifying the MiniMax Token Plan 2056 message as a periodic usage limit did not stop the same-model retry spiral, because the retry-window owner (retry-evidence.ts) kept its English-only long-window evidence and the controller therefore still entered the retry budget. hasLongWindowRateLimitEvidence now also matches the Chinese usage/quota cap phrasing; CJK text has no word boundaries, so it checks separately from the ASCII pattern, the same way the short-window owner already handles its Chinese phrases. * fix(failover): share Chinese quota exhaustion evidence Recognize the reported MiniMax Token Plan 2056 wording and exhausted Chinese quotas at the canonical message-pattern owner. Reuse that predicate for retry decisions and retain transient-throttle negative controls at the recovery boundary. Fixes #172165. Original fix by @skyzhao1223; maintainer cleanup removes the duplicate matcher and replaces helper-only assertions with consumer coverage. Co-authored-by: skyzhao1223 * test(failover): cover Chinese quota classification at its consumer Replace incorrect verbatim reply expectations with the reported MiniMax wording in the classification corpus, including its representative ID. Existing reply sanitization remains unchanged; the fix concerns retry and classification behavior. --------- Co-authored-by: skyzhao1223 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
